profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ DISH Network | Developing AI Solutions
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer II at DISH Network, I contribute to the development and implementation of solutions in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLM). My work is supported by a strong foundation in computer science and technical expertise with tools such as Git, enabling me to address complex challenges and deliver impactful results.  

I hold a Master’s degree in Computer Science from San Diego State University and a Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology from Dharmsinh Desai University. My academic and professional journey reflects a commitment to leveraging cutting-edge technologies to drive innovation and achieve organizational objectives.
